Author: Starlit Systems
Name: Honorific Carousel
Punchline: Rotate your saved Honorific titles on a per-character timer.
Description: Honorific Carousel rotates saved Honorific title presets for the current character through Honorific IPC. It keeps Honorific as the source of truth for title text and styling while letting each configured character cycle through their own sequence.

Author: Starlit Systems
Name: SubLedger
Punchline: An accounting ledger for your Free Company submarines.
Description: SubLedger watches your submarine voyage results and keeps an exact, permanent record of what every voyage earned at NPC vendor prices. It only observes: it never clicks, sends or changes anything, so it runs happily alongside whatever you use to collect and redeploy. Tracks every submarine, character and Free Company separately or combined, imports your existing SubmarineTracker history, and keeps dated backups of its ledger. Open it with /subledger.
